body: Setting the size only once means that the text won't update when the window is resized.
It updates every time `refresh_project` is called.
...which is not called when resizing the window, so the space is not properly utilized until you refresh the project.
Ahh, ok got it
Fixed
Should be in `NOTIFICATION_RESIZED` I think.

Why are you using int reference here? This completely breaks the logic; only the first element gets updated, because other controls use the updated value.

Why do you even need the cache?

Don't use index operator on vectors
```suggestion
	int window_size = SceneTree::get_singleton()->get_root()->get_size().x;
```

I'm usng ints because only the `x` value needs to be considered when resizing. The cache is used to keep track of the current size of the `project_title` so it can be updated using the cached size instead of the size returned by `project_title->get_size()`. The size cache makes it so that when a tag gets added or removed, there is still and up to date reference of the size of `project_title` because it gets removed when the control is deleted.
doesn't work in `NOTIFICATION_RESIZED`.
